title: WaterSound Condo Rentals | Beach Rentals in WaterSound, FL – Dune Vacation Rentals
meta_description: WaterSound condo rentals allow you to enjoy the privacy of WaterSound Beach, with spacious condos you would think were townhomes! Book a private escape in WaterSound, Florida. Just a few minutes east from WaterColor, Florida.
description_expanded:
Compass Point 1 #308 - WaterSound

Luxury condo rental with beautiful beach and sunset views! Sleeps 8, 3 bathrooms.

When you walk down the hallway into the open concept living space, your eyes will be drawn to the large, rotunda windows with views over the dunes and out to the gulf. You will spend hours looking at this gorgeous view and watching the sunset each night. The property is decorated in creamy whites and shades of blue and provides an atmosphere of complete relaxation.

The kitchen features all stainless appliances, granite counter tops with a pop of aqua subway tile behind the stove. The large island has 4 barstools to provide extra dining seating. The large dining table has seating for 6. When the sun is setting, you can choose the balcony located just off of the kitchen which is equipped with a dining table with 4 chairs and a high top table with 2 chairs. There is also a balcony off of the dining/living area which has two chaise lounge chairs where you can laze the day away soaking up the sun.

If you love waking up to gulf views every morning, this is the condo for you! All 3 bedrooms have gulf views! The master bedroom is located just off of the living area and has full Southern and Western views over the dunes to the water. The master has a king sized bed and an ensuite bathroom with a shower and a soaking tub. The 2 guest bedrooms are located just down the hall from the kitchen. One bedroom has 2 queen sized beds and an ensuite bathroom with a tub/shower combination and the last bedroom has a king sized bed with an ensuite bathroom with a shower.

The condo also has an office workspace and full washer and dryer. Also located on the grounds is a private pool for Compass Point Condo guests and there is also access to the Dunesider pool directly across the street from the building. The beach walkover boardwalk is directly behind the Dunesider pool.

*This home does not have access to the Watersound Beach Club. The Beach Club is a private, members only club and day passes cannot be purchased.*

*Construction notice: Construction materials, noises, and work may be present during your stay as the building is undergoing renovations per the HOA.*

~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

Home Highlights:

- Sleeps 8

- 1,818 Square Feet

- Large rotunda windows with floor to ceiling views of the Gulf, dunes and beach

- 2 large king bedrooms with en-suite bathrooms and a third bedroom with 2 queen sized beds and en-suite bathroom

- 3 full bathrooms

- High ceilings and luxurious decor in a coastal color palette. So Relaxing!

- Open-concept living space with 2 balconies

- TVs in all bedrooms plus a wall-mounted flat screen in the living room

- 2 Private balconies - 1 off of the dining/living area with two chaise loungers and another accessible by the kitchen with a high top table and a round dining table.

- Full sized washer and dryer in unit

- Parking for a maximum of 2 vehicles.

- Other amenities include elevator access from the garage to the 4th floor, access to the private Compass Point 2 pool, as well as the Dunesider pool across the parking lot from Compass Point 1, access to the WaterSound beach via the beach walkover boardwalk

- Beach Front

Additional

- There is an elevator from the garage/ground floor that takes you up to the 3rd floor just steps away from the condo

- No Events, such as wedding receptions and other large gatherings are allowed. Only people sleeping in the home are allowed on this property. If violated, double cleaning fees, as well as other possible fees, will apply.

- Non smoking home.

- No pet home. Per the signed Rental Agreement, any violation of the no pet policy will result in immediate eviction, plus additional clean charges.

- WaterSound community does not allow any golf cart rentals or guests to bring their own golf carts

Reservation/ Booking Policy

- Minimum age: All properties require a minimum of one adult over the age of 26 be staying at the property throughout the rental term.

- A 50% deposit is due at the time of booking

- Except for a $250 cancellation fee, deposits are fully refundable if cancellations are given 60 days prior to the arrival date

- Balance of payment is due 60 days prior to arrival date

- Check-in begins at 4:00 PM and check-out is by 10:00 AM

- Cleaning: Reservations made for more than 12 nights require a full clean during your stay. This will be added onto your total when checking out. Reservations for less than 12 days, have the option to add a mid-stay clean onto your reservation.
